posts.texte: GTA 6 is officially 4 days out from launch.

GTA 6 developers are receiving signed copies from Rockstar and many are taking a well deserved break ahead of launch.

More than 1600 employees across the UK are currently voting on whether to form a union, which will provide a framework for them to negotiate pay, overtime,
